boundaries.name: poseidon-hash
boundaries.obligation: PoseidonHashOut::hash_inputs_u64 and PoseidonHashOutTarget::hash_inputs are opaque callbacks; no collision resistance, preimage resistance or injectivity is established here.

boundaries.name: native-target-hash-agreement
boundaries.obligation: That the native Poseidon and the in-circuit Poseidon gadget compute the same function is assumed by using one callback for both transcriptions.

boundaries.name: goldilocks-canonicality
boundaries.obligation: safe_split_lo_and_hi / split_le canonicality of field elements is uninterpreted; the model only assumes hash elements fit in u64.

boundaries.name: plonky2-gate-lowering
boundaries.obligation: No proof that the Lean gate predicates correspond to the constraints the Rust builder emits (range_check, connect, split_le).

boundaries.name: recipient-248-bit-commitment
boundaries.obligation: The tag overwrites the top byte of the hash output, so recipient equality only constrains 248 bits; collision resistance of that truncation is not established.
